note: Operational and insurance diligence request list. phase: phase1, phase2 (conversations and on-site time happen after the phase-1 gate), decision. Tags for --exclude: employees, field-crews, inventory, vehicles, software, recurring-contracts, online-marketing.

requests.request: Organization chart and employee census: role, tenure, full/part-time, pay rate, hours, W-2 or 1099, licenses or certifications, start date (no SSNs or birth dates)
requests.why: Who does the work, cost, key people, classification signals

requests.request: List of everyone paid as a contractor (1099) in the last 2 years, what they do, hours, how they're paid and whether they work for others
requests.why: Classification facts for counsel and the CPA

requests.request: Benefits summary: health, retirement plan, PTO policy and accrued balances, bonuses and commissions owed
requests.why: Costs the buyer takes on; accrued amounts settled at closing

requests.request: Turnover in the last 2 years: who left, role, why
requests.why: Retention and culture

requests.request: Owner's weekly schedule and list of tasks only the owner does (estimating, sales, key accounts, licenses, banking)
requests.why: Owner dependence; what the buyer or a hire must take over

requests.request: Key employees identified, with seller's view on retention and the timing of telling them
requests.why: Key-person risk; retention plan before closing

requests.request: Employee handbook, safety program and training records
requests.why: Operating practices and compliance

requests.request: Seller-agreed plan and timing for customer conversations (who, when, how introduced)
requests.why: Customer calls need the seller's consent

requests.request: Customer calls completed and notes recorded (top customers by revenue)
requests.why: Will customers stay with a new owner?

requests.request: Recurring contracts or service agreements: count, renewal dates, cancellation history
requests.why: Revenue durability

requests.request: Pricing sheets, standard quotes and recent price changes
requests.why: How the business prices and whether there's room

requests.request: Key suppliers: who, what, terms, alternatives, any personal relationship with the owner
requests.why: Supply continuity

requests.request: Systems inventory: every software tool, what it's used for, account holder, monthly cost, data export ability
requests.why: What runs the business and what must transfer

requests.request: Read-only look at the job management or CRM system for a sample of 20 records
requests.why: Data quality test

requests.request: Lead sources for the last 2 years: leads, jobs won and spend by source
requests.why: Where customers come from and what each costs

requests.request: Website, online review profiles, ads accounts and social accounts: access to view analytics and reviews
requests.why: Marketing health and transferability

requests.request: Referral relationships and how much revenue they bring (and whether they depend on the owner)
requests.why: Owner-dependent lead flow

requests.request: Equipment and vehicle list with age, condition and maintenance records
requests.why: Capex and reliability

requests.request: Inventory management process and last physical count
requests.why: Shrink, obsolescence, working capital

requests.request: Shadowing days scheduled with the seller (office and field)
requests.why: See how the business actually runs

requests.request: Ride-along or site visits with field crews
requests.why: Quality of work and crew practices

requests.request: Copies of all current insurance policies with declarations pages
requests.why: What is covered today and gaps

requests.request: Loss runs from each insurer, last 5 years
requests.why: Claims history drives the buyer's premiums and reveals problems

requests.request: Identify claims-made policies (professional, E&O, cyber, employment practices) and tail coverage needs
requests.why: Claims for pre-closing acts may be uncovered without tail

requests.request: Workers' comp experience and any open claims
requests.why: Cost and safety record

requests.request: Buyer's insurance quotes and lender's insurance requirements (property, liability, life, others)
requests.why: Must be bound by closing; lender sets requirements
